# Agent Office CLI prompt layout release

Release SHA:        d8e7e6307afbdda409a460c63e2d2ede84d47d0b

This identifies the application candidate. The final RC is the release PR head
including this record. Rollback SHA: `cd1f29bfc283b6b910a33a2d36a1e8775ba8bac8`.

Selected change: #3015, feature head `7b00e3f2183b77074130e125322778ce86edf854`.
Its three-file patch applied cleanly to the observed production main base.
Prompts use right-aligned gray bubbles; the docked monitor and office share a
responsive height. Replies, raw output, collection and authorization retain
their existing behavior. No collector configuration or worker activation changes.

The owner requested these two UI refinements after authorizing the CLI feature's
PR creation, merge, deployment and standalone release path on 2026-10-25.
The release is prepared separately while the develop merge lane is occupied.
The source PR's merge and dev deployment must be confirmed before main merge.

Completed evidence:

- [x] Source validation passed 110 focused tests and 12 browser regression
  groups, including four viewport sizes, long prompt wrapping, read-only
  controls, raw output and pause/resume. ESLint and whitespace checks passed.
- [x] The exact main-based candidate passed the same 110 focused tests and all
  12 browser groups again, with no application changes during release assembly.
- [x] All 17 source-PR CI checks passed; only two obsolete draft matrix
  placeholders were skipped.

Final RC CI, Test SUCCESS/build-info, production SUCCESS/build-info and
main-to-develop ancestry are recorded in the release PR.

Test's owner UI remains restricted by its existing Cloudflare account-member
gate. This does not change that gate. The real components are exercised with
synthetic browser fixtures, followed by the actual production owner Office
after deployment. No actual CLI content is published in the release record.
